tlabel: Accrued interest receivable
doc: Interest, dividends, rents, ancillary and other revenues earned but not yet received by the entity on its investments.

tlabel: Accumulated other comprehensive loss
doc: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

tlabel: Incremental shares excluded from EPS calculation
doc: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) or earnings per unit (EPU) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS or EPU because to do so would increase EPS or EPU amounts or decrease loss per share or unit amounts for the period presented.

tlabel: Assets
doc: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

tlabel: Cash and cash equivalents
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect and Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change and including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: COMMITMENTS AND CONTINGENCIES
doc: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is exposed to potential losses or, less frequently, gains, arising from (a) possible claims against a company's resources due to future performance under contract terms, and (b) possible losses or likely gains from uncertainties that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events that are deemed likely to occur do occur or fail to occur.

tlabel: Common stock, shares authorized
doc: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

tlabel: Common stock, shares issued
doc: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

tlabel: Common stock, shares outstanding
doc: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

tlabel: Common stock, no par value; authorized 75,000,000 shares; 21,842,457 and 21,432,698 shares issued and outstanding at December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024, respectively
doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

tlabel: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income (loss) and other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

tlabel: Total debt outstanding
doc: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

tlabel: Deferred tax assets, net
doc: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

tlabel: Total deferred
doc: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

tlabel: Depreciation and amortization
doc: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

tlabel: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
doc: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

tlabel: Basic
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Diluted
doc: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

tlabel: General and administrative
doc: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

tlabel: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Income taxes
doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

tlabel: Income tax expense (benefit)
doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

tlabel: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating
doc: Represents the total of interest and dividend income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, earned from (1) loans and leases whether held-for-sale or held-in-portfolio; (2) investment securities; (3) federal funds sold; (4) securities purchased under agreements to resell; (5) investments in banker's acceptances, commercial paper, or certificates of deposit; (6) dividend income; or (7) other investments not otherwise specified herein.

tlabel: Interest expense
doc: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.

tlabel: Interest
doc: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

tlabel: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activity
doc: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

tlabel: Liabilities [Default Label]
doc: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

tlabel: Liabilities and Equity
doc: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

tlabel: Finance receivables measured at fair value
doc: Fair value portion of loan receivable, including, but not limited to, mortgage loans held for investment, finance receivables held for investment, policy loans on insurance contracts.

tlabel: Total
doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

tlabel: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

tlabel: Net income
doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

tlabel: Occupancy
doc: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

tlabel: Operating cash flows from operating leases
doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

tlabel: Other comprehensive income (loss); change in funded status of pension plan, net of ($433), $681 and $422 in tax for 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively
doc: Amount, after tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

tlabel: Other comprehensive income (loss)
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

tlabel: Preferred stock, par value
doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

tlabel: Preferred stock, shares authorized
doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

tlabel: Preferred stock, shares issued
doc: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

tlabel: Preferred stock, value
doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

tlabel: Proceeds from issuance of subordinated renewable notes
doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from issuance of securitization trust debt
doc: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

tlabel: Payments received on finance receivables held for investment
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Exercise of options and warrants
doc: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Furniture and equipment, net
doc: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

tlabel: Receivables, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of receivables, including, but not limited to, trade account receivables, note receivables, and loan receivables.

tlabel: Repayments of Secured Debt
doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

tlabel: Restricted cash and equivalents
doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Retained earnings
doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

tlabel: Revenues
doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

tlabel: Employee costs
doc: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer employee. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

tlabel: Shares, Outstanding
doc: Number of shares issued which are neither cancelled nor held in the treasury.

tlabel: Equity, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
doc: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

tlabel: Stock-based compensation
doc: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

tlabel: Total stock purchases, shares
doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

tlabel: Denominator for diluted earnings per share
doc: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

tlabel: Denominator for basic earnings per share - weighted average number of common shares outstanding during the year
doc: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

tlabel: Accrued liabilities
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities.

tlabel: Additional paid-in capital
doc: Amount of excess of issue price over par or stated value of stock and from other transaction involving stock or stockholder. Includes, but is not limited to, additional paid-in capital (APIC) for common and preferred stock.

tlabel: Stock-based compensation options
doc: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Common stock, par value
doc: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

tlabel: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

tlabel: Dividends, Preferred Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Dividend paid in cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

tlabel: Effect of currency rate exchange on cash and cash equivalents
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Intangible asset
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts of all intangible assets, excluding goodwill, as of the balance sheet date, net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges.

tlabel: Interest receivable
doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

tlabel: Net loss attributable to common stockholders
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Other assets
doc: Amount of assets classified as other.

tlabel: Foreign currency translation
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other Liabilities
doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Other expense
doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Preferred stock, shares outstanding
doc: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

tlabel: Proceeds from issuance of preferred stock
doc: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

tlabel: Consulting fees
doc: Professional and contract service expense includes cost reimbursements for support services related to contracted projects, outsourced management, technical and staff support.

tlabel: Recognized gain (loss)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment.

tlabel: Stock issued for compensation - RSUs
doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Stock issued for warrant exercises
doc: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

tlabel: Treasury stock, common shares
doc: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

tlabel: Treasury stock, value
doc: Amount allocated to previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date, including liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, compensation costs, payroll taxes and fringe benefits (other than pension and postretirement obligations), contractual rights and obligations, and statutory obligations.

tlabel: Accrued Liabilities and Other Liabilities
doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid nor invoiced, and liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
doc: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

tlabel: Deposits
doc: The aggregate of all deposit liabilities held by the entity, including foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing; may include demand deposits, saving deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits among others.

tlabel: Employee-related Liabilities
doc: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

tlabel: Other Expenses
doc: Amount of expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net
doc: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

tlabel: Short-Term Debt
doc: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
doc: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

tlabel: Offering costs reclassified to APIC
doc: Amount of other increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC).

tlabel: Amortization of intangible assets
doc: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of intangible assets (nonphysical assets not used in production) in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit from such assets.

tlabel: Less: accumulated amortization
doc: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

tlabel: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, after Accumulated Amortization
doc: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

tlabel: Redemption of Series B Preferred Stock and accrued dividends
doc: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.

tlabel: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments
doc: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

tlabel: Proceeds from sale of common stock
doc: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

tlabel: Net loss allocable to common shareholders used to compute basic and diluted loss per common share
doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value
doc: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

tlabel: Proceeds from long-term debt
doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Shares issued for acquisition, valued at $0.0005 per share
doc: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

tlabel: Net income (loss) attributable to minority interest
doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Equity Balance
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

tlabel: Interest income (expense)
doc: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

tlabel: Due to related parties, current
doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

tlabel: Right-to-Use Asset
doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

tlabel: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of debt instrument payable, including, but not limited to, notes payable and loans payable.

tlabel: Marketing and brand assessment
doc: The total expense recognized in the period for promotion, public relations, and brand or product advertising.

tlabel: Present value of lease liabilities
doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

tlabel: Borrowed amount
doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date for the aggregate of other miscellaneous borrowings owed by the reporting entity.

tlabel: Other income, net
doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from issuance of debt
doc: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from sale of property and equipment
doc: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

tlabel: Proceeds from term loan, net of issuance costs of $149,913
doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Conversion of Convertible Notes for Preferred Stock, shares
doc: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of the conversion of convertible securities.

tlabel: Conversion of Convertible Notes for Preferred Stock
doc: The gross value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities.

tlabel: Repurchases of common stock
doc: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Value
doc: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

tlabel: Derivative Asset
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Derivative Liability
doc: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Equity, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest
doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.

tlabel: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
doc: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

tlabel: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
doc: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards forfeited during the period.

tlabel: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
doc: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Shares, Acquired
doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and are being held in treasury.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
doc: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

tlabel: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted, Adjustment
doc: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.

tlabel: Other investing activities
doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

tlabel: Payments of Dividends
doc: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Issuance of shares for employee stock option plan
doc: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of trade and related party payables and accrued expenses.

tlabel: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

tlabel: Accretion (Amortization) of Discounts and Premiums, Investments
doc: The sum of the periodic adjustments of the differences between securities' face values and purchase prices that are charged against earnings. This is called accretion if the security was purchased at a discount and amortization if it was purchased at premium. As a noncash item, this element is an adjustment to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Recognition and Exercise
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition and exercise of award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Issuance Costs
doc: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from direct costs associated with issuing stock. Includes, but is not limited to, legal and accounting fees and direct costs associated with stock issues under a shelf registration.

tlabel: Advance from Federal Home Loan Bank
doc: Amount of borrowings as of the balance sheet date from the Federal Home Loan Bank, which are primarily used to cover shortages in the required reserve balance and liquidity shortages.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost
doc: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Beneficial Interest Liability
doc: Obligation reflecting another party's right to economic interests in another entity or trust under a contractual right. For example, an investor may purchase a beneficial interest in a securitization transaction.

tlabel: Brokerage Commissions Revenue
doc: Amount of commission revenue from buying and selling securities on behalf of customers.

tlabel: Business Development
doc: Business development involves the development of products and services, their delivery, design and their implementation. Business development includes a number of techniques designed to grow an economic enterprise. Such techniques include, but are not limited to, assessments of marketing opportunities and target markets, intelligence gathering on customers and competitors, generating leads for possible sales, follow-up sales activity, formal proposal writing and business model design. Business development involves evaluating a business and then realizing its full potential, using such tools as marketing, sales, information management and customer service.

tlabel: Capital Accumulation Plans
doc: Value of stock in an investment or savings plan established by the entity for the benefit of its employees that permits the employees to make investment decisions.

tlabel: Cash and Due from Banks
doc: For banks and other depository institutions: Includes cash on hand (currency and coin), cash items in process of collection, noninterest bearing deposits due from other financial institutions (including corporate credit unions), and noninterest bearing balances with the Federal Reserve Banks, Federal Home Loan Banks and central banks.

tlabel: Cash and Securities Segregated under Federal and Other Regulations
doc: Amount of cash subject to withdrawal restrictions, restricted deposits held as compensating balances, and cash and securities segregated in compliance with regulations (such as cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers).

tlabel: Commercial Paper
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of short-term borrowings using unsecured obligations issued by banks, corporations and other borrowers to investors. The maturities of these money market securities generally do not exceed 270 days.

tlabel: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
doc: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

tlabel: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
doc: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

tlabel: Common Stock Issued, Employee Stock Trust
doc: Value of common stock issued to a trust (for example, a 'rabbi trust') set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees. This trust does not allow employees to immediately or after a holding period diversify into nonemployer securities. The deferred compensation plan for which this trust is set up must be settled by the delivery of a fixed number of shares of employer stock.

tlabel: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital
doc: Amount of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock issued.

tlabel: Common Stock, Value, Outstanding
doc: Value of common shares held by shareholders. Excludes common shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.

tlabel: Communication
doc: The amount of expense incurred in the period for communication, which is the exchange of information by several methods.

tlabel: Communications and Information Technology
doc: The amount of expense in the period for communications and data processing expense.

tlabel: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

tlabel: Costs and Expenses
doc: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest
doc: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Excluding Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale and Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest
doc: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Realized Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest
doc: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Excluding Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Debt Securities, Trading, Restricted
doc: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

tlabel: Deposits, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of deposit liabilities held by the entity, including, but not limited to, foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing, demand deposits, saving deposits, negotiable orders of withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits.

tlabel: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
doc: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

tlabel: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
doc: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

tlabel: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Including Discontinued Operation
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

tlabel: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees
doc: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.

tlabel: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value
doc: Fair value of obligations incurred from short sales.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest
doc: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: Includes: (1) the amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements (Federal Funds Sold) and (2) the dollar amount outstanding of funds lent in the form of security resale agreements regardless of maturity, if the agreement requires the bank to resell the identical security purchased or a security that meets the definition of substantially the same in the case of a dollar roll. Also include purchases of participations in pools of securities, regardless of maturity (Securities Purchased Under Agreements to Re-sell).

tlabel: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Borrowed or Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of federal funds sold and securities borrowed or purchased under agreements to resell.

tlabel: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: Amount after offset of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

tlabel: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Loaned or Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

tlabel: Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees
doc: The amount of expense during the period for floor brokerage fees paid to other broker-dealers to execute trades on their behalf, stock exchange fees, order flow fees, and clearance fees.

tlabel: Gain (Loss) on Investments
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
doc: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

tlabel: Goodwill
doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value
doc: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

tlabel: Incentive Fee Expense
doc: Amount of expense for incentive fee based on performance under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

tlabel: Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

tlabel: Income Tax Paid, before Refund Received
doc: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) Due from Affiliates
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities and Other Operating Liabilities
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued expenses, and obligations classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Salaries
doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in accrued salaries.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due to the entity related to activities and operations with other broker dealers, and clearing organizations, including deposits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Borrowed Securities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is pledged as security when borrowing securities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Loaned Securities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is received as security when loaning securities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Affiliates
doc: The increase (decrease) in obligations owed to an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Net
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash inflow or outflow from investment sold under the agreement to reacquire such investment.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of financial instruments used in operating activities, including trading securities, risk management instruments, and other short-term trading instruments.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Loan, Held-for-Sale
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deposits
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in deposit liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Receivables
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables classified as other.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Payable to Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations incurred arising from transactions with broker-dealers, such as amounts due on margin and unsettled cash transactions; includes payables to brokers, dealers and clearing organizations.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Customers
doc: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in amounts payable to customers. The term customers generally excludes other broker-dealers; persons who are principal officers, directors, and stockholders; and persons whose securities or funds are part of the regulatory net capital of the broker-dealer. Another broker-dealer's account can be classified as a customer if the account is carried as an omnibus account in compliance with certain regulations. The accounts of principal officers, directors and stockholders may be combined in the customer captions if they are not material and the combination is disclosed in the oath that is required to accompany the annual audited FOCUS Report.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Payables under Repurchase Agreements
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability under agreements to repurchase securities that were sold.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Borrowed
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity arising from securities borrowed transactions.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Loaned Transactions
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability arising from securities loaned transactions.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits
doc: Net cash inflow (outflow) of time deposits.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Trading Liabilities
doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of trading liabilities from the reporting entity's trading activities. This include liabilities resulting from sales of assets that the reporting entity does not own and revaluation losses.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt and equity securities, measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) of Restricted Investments
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

tlabel: Information Technology and Data Processing
doc: The amount of expenses incurred in the period for information technology and data processing products and services.

tlabel: Interest Income, Operating
doc: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

tlabel: Interest-Bearing Deposits in Banks and Other Financial Institutions
doc: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

tlabel: Interest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign
doc: Amount of foreign interest-bearing deposits held by the entity.

tlabel: Interest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
doc: Total amount of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities, which may include brokered, retail, demand, checking, notice of withdrawal, money market and other interest-bearing deposits.

tlabel: Investment Banking Revenue
doc: Includes (1) underwriting revenue (the spread between the resale price received and the cost of the securities and related expenses) generated through the purchasing, distributing and reselling of new issues of securities (alternatively, could be a secondary offering of a large block of previously issued securities); and (2) fees earned for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, and other types of financial advisory services.

tlabel: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend
doc: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

tlabel: Investments
doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all investments.

tlabel: Labor and Related Expense
doc: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit.

tlabel: Loan, Held-for-Sale, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of loans held-for-sale including, but not limited to, mortgage loans and finance receivables.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, of financing receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

tlabel: Long-Term Debt, Fair Value
doc: The fair value amount of long-term debt whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission.

tlabel: Marketable Securities
doc: Amount of investment in marketable security.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest in Operating Partnerships
doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners in an operating partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

tlabel: Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
doc: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Portion of net income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

tlabel: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after income tax of income (loss) including the portion attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest. Excludes the portion attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest recognized as temporary equity.

tlabel: Nonfinancial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value of obligations not classified as financial liabilities. Includes, but is not limited to, accounts payable and accrued liabilities, commitments, obligations, and other liabilities.

tlabel: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities
doc: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

tlabel: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
doc: Amount of domestic noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity, which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

tlabel: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign
doc: Amount of foreign noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

tlabel: Noninterest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Demand
doc: Amount of money in noninterest-bearing domestic accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.

tlabel: Noninterest Expense
doc: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

tlabel: Noninterest Income
doc: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

tlabel: Noninterest Income, Other
doc: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

tlabel: Noninterest Income, Other Operating Income
doc: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.

tlabel: Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity which is not redeemable by the parent entity.

tlabel: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

tlabel: Off-Balance-Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability
doc: Amount of expected credit loss for credit exposure on off-balance-sheet commitment, including but not limited to, loan commitment, standby letter of credit, financial guarantee not accounted for as insurance. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

tlabel: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of other assets.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount before tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax
doc: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
doc: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax
doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments and Tax, Parent
doc: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge, attributable to parent. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to parent.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, before Tax
doc: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Net of Tax
doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
doc: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

tlabel: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
doc: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

tlabel: Other Investments
doc: Amount of investments classified as other.

tlabel: Other Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of other liabilities.

tlabel: Other Noninterest Expense
doc: Amount of noninterest expense classified as other.

tlabel: Other Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

tlabel: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Other Item
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

tlabel: Other Receivables
doc: Amount due from parties in nontrade transactions, classified as other.

tlabel: Other Secured Financings
doc: Secured financing other than securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

tlabel: Other Short-Term Borrowings
doc: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Contributions
doc: Total contributions made by each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Distributions
doc: Total distributions to each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Redemptions
doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to redemptions and adjustments to redemption value. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Purchased
doc: Value of units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital account for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units
doc: The number of each class of partnership units outstanding at the balance sheet date. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Redeemed
doc: The number of units redeemed during the year of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

tlabel: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Purchased
doc: Units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

tlabel: Partners' Capital, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

tlabel: Broker-Dealer, Payable to Other Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
doc: Amount payable to other broker-dealer and clearing organization, including, but not limited to, security failed-to-receive, deposit received for security loaned, open transaction, and floor-brokerage payable.

tlabel: Broker-Dealer, Payable to Customer
doc: Amount payable to customer by broker-dealer.

tlabel: Payment for Origination and Purchase, Loan, Held-for-Sale
doc: The aggregate amount of cash outflow for loans purchased and created with the intention to resell them in the near future.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with the acquisition or sale of a business segment during the period.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable
doc: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Loans and Leases
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for other changes, net, in the loan and lease balances held for investment purposes that are not separately disclosed. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

tlabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

tlabel: Payments for Repurchase of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
doc: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

tlabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends
doc: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.

tlabel: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Held-to-Maturity Securities
doc: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

tlabel: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
doc: The cash outflow from (a) purchases of loans held-for-investment, (b) purchases of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

tlabel: Payments to Acquire Other Investments
doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.

tlabel: Payment for Pension Benefits
doc: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

tlabel: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
doc: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
doc: Aggregate par value plus amounts in excess of par or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock) for nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding, net of discount on shares. Aggregate for preferred stock issued and outstanding.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference, Value
doc: Value of the difference between preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the preferred shares.

tlabel: Preferred Stock Redemption Premium
