doc: The excess of (1) fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock over (2) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet, during the accounting period.

tlabel: Principal Investment Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss), from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, and includes, but is not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

tlabel: Principal Transactions Revenue, Net
doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) resulting from the difference between acquisition price and selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, and from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, including, but not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

tlabel: Proceeds from FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash inflow from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Income Tax Refunds
doc: Amount of income tax refund received from tax jurisdiction.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities, Net
doc: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

tlabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-Maturity Securities
doc: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.

tlabel: Proceeds from Other Short-Term Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net
doc: The cash flow from the funds lent to and (borrowed from) other financial reporting institutions arising from excess or shortfall in reserve deposited at the Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirements. This lending and borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash outflow or inflow from investments purchased under the agreement to resell such investment.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Interest-Bearing Deposits in Banks
doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in Interest-bearing Deposits by banks in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Payment for) Other Financing Activity
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
doc: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

tlabel: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt
doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Reserve Bank Stock
doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
doc: The net cash inflow from (a) sales of loans held-for-investment, (b) sales of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both. Includes proceeds from securitizations of loans.

tlabel: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

tlabel: Professional Fees
doc: A fee charged for services from professionals such as doctors, lawyers and accountants. The term is often expanded to include other professions, for example, pharmacists charging to maintain a medicinal profile of a client or customer.

tlabel: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

tlabel: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

tlabel: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
doc: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

tlabel: Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
doc: Amount receivable from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, including, but not limited to, securities failed-to-deliver, certain deposits for securities borrowed, open transactions, good faith and margin deposits, commissions and floor brokerage receivables.

tlabel: Receivable from Customer in Brokerage
doc: Amount due from customers for fees and charges arising from transactions related to the entity's brokerage activities and operations.

tlabel: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Carrying Amount
doc: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

tlabel: Repayments of Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of lease obligation.

tlabel: Payments of FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
doc: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

tlabel: Repayments of Long-Term Debt
doc: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayment of Long-Term Debt, Long-Term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security
doc: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.

tlabel: Repayments of Other Short-Term Debt
doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

tlabel: Repayments of Unsecured Debt
doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt unsecured debt.

tlabel: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

tlabel: Revenues, Net of Interest Expense
doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

tlabel: Securities Borrowed
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Securities Borrowed, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of securities borrowed from other entities.

tlabel: Securities Loaned
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Securities Loaned or Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Fair value portion of securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

tlabel: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes purchases of participations in pools of securities that are subject to a resale agreement, assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

tlabel: Short-Term Debt, Fair Value
doc: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents the amount of short-term debt existing as of the balance sheet date.

tlabel: Stock and Warrants Issued During Period, Value, Preferred Stock and Warrants
doc: Value of preferred stock and warrants for common stock issued.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Other
doc: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

tlabel: Stockholders' Equity, Other Shares
doc: Number of increase (decrease) in shares of stock classified as other.

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units
doc: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

tlabel: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units
doc: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Including Noncontrolling Interest
doc: Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Foreign Currency Translation Adjustments
doc: Adjustments to temporary equity resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Other Changes
doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in temporary equity from changes classified as other.

tlabel: Trading Gain (Loss)
doc: Amount of gain (loss) resulting from the difference between the acquisition price and the selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, conducted separately from customer trading activities. Includes, but is not limited to, changes in fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities.

tlabel: Trading Liabilities
doc: The carrying amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date that pertain to principal and customer trading transactions, or which may be incurred with the objective of generating a profit from short-term fluctuations in price as part of an entity's market-making, hedging and proprietary trading. Examples include short positions in securities, derivatives and commodities, obligations under repurchase agreements, and securities borrowed arrangements.

tlabel: Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
doc: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Par Value Method
doc: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the par value method.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives
doc: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of derivative instruments, including options, swaps, futures, and forward contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

tlabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investments
doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

tlabel: Unsecured Long-Term Debt, Noncurrent
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

doc: Fees And Commissions, Foreign Exchange Trading Services

doc: Fees And Commissions, Front Office Software And Data

doc: Fees And Commissions, Management Fees

doc: Fees And Commissions, Securities Finance

doc: Fees And Commissions, Servicing Fees

doc: Net (Decrease) Increase in Other Short-Term Borrowings

tlabel: Net (Increase) Decrease In Federal Funds Sold And Securities Purchased Under Resale Agreements
doc: Net (increase) decrease in federal funds sold and securities purchased under resale agreements

tlabel: Noncash Adjustments For Depreciation Amortization Accretion
doc: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion, excluding amortization of intangibles, recognized during the period.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Change in Net Unrealized Gain Loss on AFS Securities, Net of Reclass and Expected Loss From OTTI, Related Taxes
doc: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Change in Net Unrealized Gain Loss on AFS Securities, Net of Reclass and Expected Loss From OTTI, Related Taxes

doc: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Minimum Pension Liability Net Adjustment, Tax

doc: Repurchases Of Common Stock For Employee Tax Withholding

doc: Securities Sold Under Repurchase Agreement, Net

doc: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, And Off-Balance Sheet Liability, Credit Loss Provision (Reversal)

tlabel: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Not Part of Disposal Group, After Valuation Allowance
doc: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Not Part of Disposal Group, After Valuation Allowance

doc: Increase (Decrease) In Financial Instruments Used In Operating Activities And Derivative Assets

doc: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits and Other Short-term Investments

tlabel: Interest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic, Fair Value Disclosure

tlabel: Payments To Acquire Debt Securities Carried At Fair Value
doc: The cash outflow to acquire debt securities carried at fair value, because they are not classified as either held-to-maturity securities or trading securities.

tlabel: Preferred Stock, Redeemable And NonRedeemable, Value
doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable and redeemable preferred stock (including Series T which may be exercised, at the option of the holder, through tendering the Series T Preferred Stock or paying cash).

tlabel: Proceeds From Maturities Prepayments And Calls Of Debt Securities, Fair Value
doc: The cash inflow associated maturities (principal being due), prepayments and calls (requests of early payments) on securities not classified as either held-to-maturity securities or trading securities which are classified as debt securities carried at fair value.

tlabel: Proceeds From Sale Of Debt Securities, Fair Value
doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of debt securities carried at fair value.

tlabel: Product Delivery And Transaction Related Expenses
doc: Expenses related to activities that support revenue generating transactions and delivery of services to customers, such as brokerage, loan, collection and foreclosure costs, postage and supplies and certain card processing costs.

tlabel: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Net Of Forfeiture
doc: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Net Of Forfeiture

tlabel: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Net Of Forfeiture
doc: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Net Of Forfeiture

tlabel: Time Deposits And Other Short-Term Investments
doc: Time deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time and other short-term investments.

tlabel: Credit Extension Commitments, Reserve For Unfunded Lending Commitments
doc: Represents the estimated probable losses related to unfunded lending commitments measured at historical cost, such as letters of credit and financial guarantees, and binding unfunded loan commitments. Unfunded lending commitments are subject to the same assessment as funded loans except utilization assumptions are considered.

tlabel: Debt Securities Carried at Fair Value, Excluding Accrued Interest
doc: Debt Securities Carried at Fair Value, Excluding Accrued Interest

tlabel: Excise Tax On Share Repurchase
doc: Excise Tax On Share Repurchase

tlabel: Financing Related Fees
doc: Income from servicing real estate mortgages, credit cards, and other financial assets held by others. May also be net of any related impairment of fair value of capitalized service costs, includes capital market fees, loan commitment, fees and credit-related trade fees.

tlabel: Foreign Exchange Revenue
doc: Foreign Exchange Revenue

tlabel: Income Loss From Continuing Operations Before Income Taxes
doc: Sum of operating profit and nonoperating income (expense) before income taxes.

tlabel: Increase (Decrease) In Payable To Customers And Broker-Dealers
doc: Increase (Decrease) In Payable To Customers And Broker-Dealers

tlabel: Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks and Other Financial Institutions, Allowance for Credit Loss
doc: Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks and Other Financial Institutions, Allowance for Credit Loss

tlabel: Interest Bearing Deposits In Federal Reserve And Other Central Banks
doc: For banks and other depository institutions: Interest-bearing deposits in Federal Reserve and other central banks for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

tlabel: Investment And Other Income
doc: Investment and other income includes income from insurance contracts, gains and losses on seed capital investments, lease residual gains, expense reimbursements from joint ventures, equity investment revenue or loss, asset-related gains, gains and losses on private equity investments, and other income (loss). Asset-related gains include loan, real estate and other asset dispositions. Expense reimbursements from joint ventures relate to expenses incurred by BNY Mellon on behalf of joint ventures. Other income (loss) primarily includes fees from transitional service agreements, other investments and various miscellaneous revenues.

tlabel: Investment Management and Performance Fees
doc: Investment Management and Performance Fees

tlabel: Net Change In Interest Bearing Deposits With Federal Reserve And Other Central Banks
doc: The net cash inflow (outflow) in interest-bearing deposits held at the Federal Reserve and other central banks for relatively short periods of time.

tlabel: Net Securities Gain (Loss)
doc: This item represents the total realized gain (loss) included in earnings for the period as a result of selling marketable securities categorized as available-for-sale or held-to-maturity. Additionally, this item would include any losses recognized for other than temporary impairments of the subject investments in debt and equity securities.

tlabel: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Defined Benefit Plan, Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, After Tax
doc: The accumulated change in the value of pension and other postretirement benefit plans during the period resulting from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency of the reporting entity, net of tax.

doc: Preferred Stock, Amortization Of Deferred Fees

doc: Bank Assessment Charges

doc: Cash and Due from Banks, Allowance for Credit Loss

tlabel: Distribution And Servicing
doc: Fees earned from mutual funds based on average assets in the funds and the sale of funds managed or administered.

tlabel: Temporary Equity, Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
doc: Temporary Equity, Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)

tlabel: Total Fee Revenue
doc: Total fee revenue

doc: Total Revenues, Including Revenue Generated by Variable Interest Entities

doc: Proceeds from Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale

tlabel: Proceeds From Prepayments And Calls Of Held-To-Maturity Securities
doc: Proceeds From Prepayments And Calls Of Held-To-Maturity Securities

tlabel: Restricted Cash, Interest-Bearing Deposits In Banks And Other Financial Institutions
doc: Restricted Cash, Interest-Bearing Deposits In Banks And Other Financial Institutions

tlabel: Securities Servicing And Treasury Services Fees
doc: Fees earned for providing securities servicing and treasury services.

tlabel: Sub-custodian And Clearing Expense
doc: Includes custodian fees incurred during an accounting period from an agent, bank, trust company, or other organization that holds and safeguards an individual's, mutual fund's, or investment company's assets for them, and clearance fees.

tlabel: Investment Management
doc: Revenues earned from management fees and incentive fees for investment management services and transaction revenues related to the firm's private wealth management.

tlabel: Issuance And Amortization Of Share Based Awards
doc: Issuance and amortization of share based awards.

tlabel: Market Making, Net
doc: Revenues include the gains or losses from marking financial assets and liabilities in the Global Markets segment at fair value.

tlabel: Nonvoting Common Stock
doc: Value of nonvoting common stock that may be calculated differently depending on whether the stock is issued at par value, no par or stated value.

tlabel: Other Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Other Investments, Fair Value Disclosure

tlabel: Other Principal Transactions
doc: Revenues include the gains or losses from marking financial assets and liabilities in the Investing & Lending segment to fair value.

tlabel: Other Secured Financings, Fair Value Disclosure
doc: Other Secured Financings, Fair Value Disclosure

tlabel: Proceeds From Repayments Of Other Secured Short Term Debt
doc: Net cash inflow (outflow) associated with changes in the short-term portion of other secured financings.

tlabel: Proceeds From Repayments Of Unsecured Short Term Debt
doc: Net cash inflow (outflow) associated with changes in unsecured short-term borrowings.

tlabel: Share Based Awards
doc: Share based awards.

tlabel: Trading Assets Including Pledge
doc: Trading assets including pledge.

tlabel: Transaction Based
doc: Transaction based.

tlabel: Treasury Stock, Common And Preferred, Shares
doc: Treasury Stock, Common And Preferred, Shares

tlabel: Unsecured Short Term Borrowings Including Current Portion Of Unsecured Long Term Borrowings
doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of unsecured short-term borrowings (with maturities due within one year) including the current portion of unsecured long-term borrowings.

tlabel: Cancellation Of Share Based Awards In Satisfaction Of Withholding Tax Requirements
doc: Cancellation of share-based awards in satisfaction of withholding tax requirements.

tlabel: Customer and Other Payables
doc: Customer and other payables.

tlabel: Lending And Deposit Related Fees
doc: Combination of: 1) Includes amounts charged depositors for: (A) maintenance of their accounts (maintenance charges); (B) failure to maintain specified minimum balances on account; (C) exceeding the number of checks or transactions allowed to be processed in a given period; (D) checks drawn on no minimum balance deposit accounts; (E) withdrawals from nontransaction deposit accounts; (F) closing savings accounts before a specified minimum period of time has elapsed; (G) accounts which have remained inactive for extended periods of time or which have become dormant; (H) checks drawn against insufficient funds that the bank assesses regardless of whether it decides to pay, return or hold the check; (I) issuing stop payment orders; (J) certifying checks; and (K) accumulating or disbursing funds deposited in IRAs or Keogh Plan accounts when not handled by the bank's trust department. This item does not include penalties assessed on the early withdrawal of time deposits. 2) This item represents the portion of monthly guaranty fees collected representing the interest imputed and recognized under the prospective interest method on the present value of the contractually stipulated guarantee payments at inception of the contract. 3) Income from servicing real estate mortgages, credit cards, and other financial assets held by others. Also include any premiums received in lieu of regular servicing fees on such loans only as earned over the life of the loans. May also be net of any related impairment of fair value of capitalized service costs. 4) Other lending-related fees.

tlabel: Mortgage Fees And Related Income
doc: Combination of: 1) The noninterest income derived from mortgage banking activities (fees and commissions), including fees earned from servicing third-party assets. 2) The adjustment to the carrying value of the rights retained or purchased to service mortgages. These adjustments are made when the estimate of the fair value is changed. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

tlabel: Trading Assets
doc: Total debt and equity financial instruments classified as (1) trading securities and (2) derivative assets. (1) The total of financial instruments that are bought and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time) or for debt and equity securities formerly categorized as available-for-sale or held-to-maturity which the entity held as of the date it opted to account for such securities at fair value. An enterprise may also categorize such a security as trading without the intent to sell it in the near term assuming the decision to categorize the security as trading occurred at acquisition; this is the reason why the trading category of investments in debt and equity securities are bought and sold "principally" for sale in the near term. Transfers into and out of the trading category should be rare. Such financial instruments that are held as of the reporting date are measured at fair value with unrealized holding gains and losses (the difference between fair value and the previously reported carrying amount) included in earnings. (2) Fair values as of the balance sheet date of all assets resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, net of the effects of master netting arrangements.
